texto: THREE DAYS AGO, FATHER LORGAN, HEAD OF THE EASTOWN SEMINAR, MYSTERIOUSLY DISAPPEARED, YOU HAVE BEEN SEND TO REPLACE HIM IN THE MEANTIME
Blessings Father. Good Morning…
We have been expecting you, here come, let me show you around. And welcome to the church.
As you know, our seminar has been on break ever since Father Lorgan’s… absence. Let me present you our students
Benedict. Aristocrat turned zealot. Leaving comfort for the Lord’s work… inspiring really.
Thomas. He lives in his own world, the family sent him here for “treatment”, turns out the kid is actually a good evangelist.
Samuel. Good kid, he’s the closest to graduating, a natural charmer. His congregation will be one to watch for.
Edgar. He’s sly as a fox. Tho hasn’t been the same since Lorgan left, they were very close.
And Steffano. Endlessly devout. Natural scholar. Not an easy talker…
They are all going to need your guidance here Father. I hope you can sooth them, this humble village needs these kids to be good leaders to them.
opcoes: Thank you for the vote of confidence
Not an easy task taking on the shoes of Lorgan.

texto: I expect it not to be wasted, but a new face might be able to reanimate spirits around here.

I would not hang Father Lorgan’s shoes just yet, we don’t know what happened to him, well not we, I don’t. The boys “know” he has been sent on break. I can’t believe they would make us lie in the house of the Lord.
opcoes: What do you think happened to Lorgan?

texto: As I told you Father, I do not know. He was overwhelmed sure… but he cared deeply for the church… for the community. He is a leader no just in faith but for the village, we are weakened by his absence…
resumo_notas: Lorgan is not only a religious leader, but a political one.

texto: I don’t know how it was with your last congregation, be here you'll have a schedule to follow Father Denver…

We start confessions at Nine A.M., I have a feeling the boys are gonna need it. Here, Lorgan left his deck of penance, it comes with instruction on the box, it may help you. Don’t go easy on them just because of Lorgan, it’s in times like these that it can really have an effect.
Since the church is closed there won’t be any masses, so you’re free to roam in the afternoon.
The day ends at ten, I’ll be helping you with any doubts, just meet me at the corridor prior to sleep.
Now go, confessions are about to start.
Now?
If not, when?
In the confessional chamber, a shadow appears on the other side of the door.
Forgive me Father, for I have sinned.
I have not confessed yet, father.
I’m sorry son, It has been a while.
It has been one week since I’ve last confessed. I have been noticing myself giving in to greed, Father. Temptation. Not of the world, but of the spirit.
I’m trying to drown it in prayer but I have only found solace in the indulgence of the bottle. The past week or so, I slipped out, drank a bit too much.

That is not who I am Father, although you have none but my visage to judge character. Well, not even that inside here. I shall not question your guidance either way, who am I to judge His work. Tho it is definitely mysterious.
opcoes: It is normal to give in to temptation "he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it."(1 Corinthians 10:13)
"Pray that ye enter not into temptation" (Luke 22:40)
Drinking is not good for you Son

texto: He truly does, doesn’t he. Faith in being provided a way out. Maybe he already has… Thank you Father.
Prayer is all I have done, I must admit the frustration. Gosh, one’s knees may not be frail from too much prayer. I shall reflect on it.
It is Father… That’s just the problem.
Forgive me Father, for I have sinned.
It has been five months since my last confession
It is a trying time isn’t it Father. With old man Lorgan out, I have lashed out at against my brethren. I have not ever been a man of wrath. But the past few days have been to unkind.
For my brothers cannot see past the thin veil. Anger cleanses my eyes. Rage touches their very core. Maybe that’s is why it is a capital sin.
Wrath is destructively effective.
opcoes: Wrath will bring you no answers "for the anger of man does not produce the righteousness of God." (James 1:19 - 20)
Anger is natural, let it full you, but carefully "Be angry and do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger, and give no opportunity to the devil." (Ephesians 4:26-27)
Tell me son, what does thou seek beyond this veil?

texto: The righteousness of God should not be tarnished under His house. But anger will only make it messier. Thank you, Father.
Gosh. Just.. Thank you Father. I was lost thinking giving in to sin was the only way to the truth. I shall stand vigilant on my wrath. Maybe you are not to be overlooked after all...

Well Father, they conceal the truth. Lorgan vanished. And yet they say he has left out of his own accord. I tell you Father, Lorgan knew a bit too much. He was becoming a liability. So they took him out of the game.
opcoes: Who is this “they” you speak of?
resumo_notas: Lorgan had secrets, what did he know?

texto: You must think me paranoid. Gosh, I just need guidance Father. Divine one. I apologize for the divergence
At night you go to your quarters, at the door. Sister Desmond awaits you.
So, Father, how has the church received you?
opcoes: The church is alright, the boys whatsoever…
Warmly, Sister. I feel right at home

texto: I see… give it some time, they’re vulnerable. Feelings are unstable, how could it not.
That’s great news, Father. We were in desperate need of warmth. I see the Lord might have sent me it’s most fiery soldier
Now, I have pressing matters to talk about. You have made quite the first impression. I haven’t seen the boys hopeful like that ever since Lorgan left.
That’s why I need your help Father.
Tell me, do you feel it?
opcoes: The Spirit? Of course I do Sister

texto: Now, I have pressing matters to talk about. You are well seen, but not yet well regarded amongst the faithful Father.
That’s is to say, they do not yet trust you, but you are well liked. We must leverage that.
I need your help Father.
Tell me, do you feel it?
opcoes: The Spirit? Of course I do Sister

texto: Now, I have pressing matters to talk about. The boys do not seem eager to get acquainted with their new Father. That’s to be expected. But it must be changed.
They need to trust the guidance coming from your hand. And In doing so. I need aid of yours.
Tell me, do you feel it?
opcoes: The Spirit? Of course I do Sister

texto: Well, that’s invigorating, but no Father. The mystery, tension amongst the boys. They are basically beaming with blame
opcoes: Do you think one of them did something?

texto: Well, the tension! You saw those boys, they are basically beaming with blame
opcoes: Do you think one of them did something?

texto: You saw it too, didn’t you. The boys, they are basically beaming with blame.
opcoes: Do you think one of them did something?

texto: Oh Lord. I know that it might sound insane. And I have prayed for these thoughts to rid of my brain.
But they persist even prayer.
I think one of them did something to Lorgan or, at least, know something about him.
Aren’t you quick.
I know that it might sound insane. And I have prayed for these thoughts to rid of my brain.
But they persist even prayer
Father, what I will ask of thou will not look sound of mind.
You may think the devil sibyls through my tongue against this congregation. Against the potencial leaders that will shepherd thousands.
But I ask for trust.
Not for me, for I am merely flesh and bones.
But for the Lord for giving me courage to talk to you about what pesters my heart.
opcoes: Well, say it at once Sister.
It's late, we shall speed at the morrow.

texto: I need of thee to investigate the seminarians. Find out what happened to Lorgan, and save the congregation, and the village with it.

texto: Yes, TROVE Inc. Their representatives have been countlessly trying to arrange meetings with Father Lorgan.
To buy the very land our church stands on.
The day after Lorgan disappeared they have appealed the Vatican for the lands.
And they gave us seven days to prove foul play.
I reckon the money Trove offered them is undeniable.

texto: But, none the less. If they get their money's worth on our lands, the village will be but a mere pawn to their game.

Walking into your room you see your belongings scattered around.
*prilililim* *prilililim*

Agent! Finally, do you copy?
How was the trip dude!! Or should I say, Father…
Oh forget it, I don’t really care. So did you find that old priest They sent you after?

texto: Gosh why do you always have to be soooo slow?
You gotta learned from me man, remember the oil rig? I put those corrupt suckers behind the bar in what like 4 hours?

texto: Well I didn’t want to go. These old churches creep me the heck out.
Oh how I missed your easy going style and love for small talk. You really are the most charismatic guy I have ever met
But enough chattering, the boss is anxious and keeping a close eye on the case, send your report for the day ASAP…
… Father…
HAHAHAHAH oh you will NEVER live that down.
I packed the compact board for you, because that’s how nice I am. Just organize the evidence and sent the pick to us.
Bye bye Father!
